title: Keep distinct passages distinct
rule: Do not flatten distinct passages into the same dry phrasing.
example: Keep one narrator’s spare tone and another’s exuberant cadence.
counterexample: Rewrite both narrators into identical short, dry statements.
rationale: Editing should not erase the differences between voices.
evidence: Migrated from existing repository guidance: `deslopify/ne-fac/_template/models/minimax/available/minimax-m3.md`. Examples are illustrative.
